areas.title: Infrastructure
areas.when: the change touches Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, containers or serverless config

items.ask: how it rolls out, in which order across environments
how it is rolled back, and what a rollback loses
what else the changed resources serve (services, environments, tenants)
which environments it reaches, and whether each has the same resources today
the permissions it adds or changes, scoped to which resources
what it adds to cost, from the resource's pricing and expected use
the limits, quotas and timeouts it meets or changes
the alarm, metric or log that shows it failing

areas.title: CI and deploy pipelines
areas.when: the change touches CI workflows or deploy pipelines

items.ask: which branches, events and environments run it
how a bad pipeline change is undone without a broken deploy
the tokens, secrets and permissions the jobs use, and their scope
which jobs, deploys or repositories depend on what changed
timeouts, concurrency and runner time it adds

areas.title: Auth and security
areas.when: the change touches authentication, authorization, IAM, WAF, secrets or untrusted input

items.ask: what someone could misuse in the change, and what stops it
who or what gains access to what, at the least it needs
where secrets and tokens come from, and that none is logged or committed
how untrusted input is validated or encoded
whether existing sessions, tokens and clients keep working, or how they move

areas.title: Data and migrations
areas.when: the change touches schemas, migrations, stored data or its shape

items.ask: how the migration runs on the real data: its size, locks and duration
old and new code both working against the data during the deploy (expand and contract)
how the data change is undone, and what a rollback keeps
each environment's data it meets, with counts from a lookup
existing rows: backfilled, defaulted or left, and why

areas.title: Performance
areas.when: the change touches a hot path, a query, a loop over stored data, caching or anything the ticket says is slow

items.ask: whether the changed code is on a hot path and how often it runs, from a lookup or the code
what each call costs now: queries, network calls, memory
the timeouts, payload sizes and rate limits it meets
how the effect is measured before and after

areas.title: Observability
areas.when: the change adds or changes alarms, metrics, dashboards, logs or tracing

items.ask: the alarm, metric or log that shows it working and the one that shows it failing
thresholds and periods, from the current baseline
who or what is notified
the expected volume, so it doesn't alert on noise
